content: Official Google MediaPipe Pose Landmarker documentation supports Python IMAGE mode for still front/side photos, a local model_asset_path, one pose, configurable detection/presence/tracking thresholds, normalized and world landmarks, and optional segmentation masks. The official overview lists a Lite bundle with 224x224 detector and 256x256 landmarker inputs, float16 data, and an on-device-oriented MobileNetV2-like model. The current PyPI release is mediapipe 1.0.1 with Windows x86-64 wheels; retain the project pin and local task asset rather than moving validation into the browser.
